facts.fact: 给奶牛起名那一条把“需要名字”理解成“需要一个叫 Name 的东西”，笑点在名字与普通名词之间
facts.anchor: ‘We need a name for this cow.’ ‘Annabel?’ ‘No, just a name.’

facts.fact: 翼龙上厕所没声音，因为 P 不发音：把拼写规则当生理事实
facts.anchor: Why can’t you hear a pterodactyl go to the bathroom? Because the ‘P’ is silent.

facts.fact: 水牛与野牛的区别：bison 听起来像 basin（洗手盆），所以“不能在 buffalo 里洗手”
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between a buffalo and a bison? You can’t wash your hands in a buffalo.

facts.fact: 乌龟被两只蜗牛抢劫后说“一切都发生得太快”，速度对照构成笑点
facts.anchor: A tortoise is crossing the road when he’s mugged by two snails.

facts.fact: 两条鱼在“tank”里：tank 兼指鱼缸与坦克，鱼把鱼缸当坦克开
facts.anchor: Two fish are in a tank. One says, ‘How do you drive this thing?’

facts.fact: 猫吃了毛线球后“有了手套”：kittens 与 mittens 谐音，猫生出小猫被说成戴手套
facts.anchor: What happened to the cat who ate a ball of wool? She had mittens.

facts.fact: 豹子不擅长捉迷藏：spotted 兼指“有斑点”和“被发现”
facts.anchor: Why are leopards so bad at hide and seek? They’re always spotted.

facts.fact: 逗章鱼发笑要用十根“tickles”：tentacles（触手）与 ten tickles 谐音
facts.anchor: How do you make an octopus laugh? With ten tickles.

facts.fact: 狗不会操作 MRI，猫却会“catscan”：把 CAT scan（CT 扫描）拆成 cat + scan
facts.anchor: Dogs can’t operate MRI machines, but catscan.
